messages:
emma: Heads-up — opening a tiny PR to add compact billing examples for tier edge-cases. Wanted to tag docs + QA before I push.

raj: Thanks emma. Can you add one example for burst credits + one for per-route quotas? Those are the two we keep getting questions about.

emma: Yep. I sketched both. Short snippets only, meant for the Quickstart 'Pricing & Quotas' panel.

kevin: Ping on the wording for burst credits — customers ask if it stacks with reserved capacity. We should be explicit: it does not.

emma: Good call. I'll add a one-liner: `Burst credits apply to hosted plans only and do not stack with Dedicated reserved-capacity guarantees.`

linda: Also add a note about billing timezones. We had support tickets where the dashboard showed daily usage in UTC which confused EU customers.

emma: Added: `All usage is recorded in UTC; billing invoices use the customer's billing timezone — see Billing FAQ (link).` Placeholder link for now.

raj: Can you paste the exact code snippet you plan to add for SDK usage? I want to check the meter header example.

emma: Sure — planning this minimal snippet (JS):

```js
const res = await client.responses.create({
  model: 'redwood-compact-1',
  input: 'Summarize usage',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Metering-Id': 'customer-1234' }
});
```

raj: That's fine. Add a comment `// include meter id to attribute usage` and show a Python variant too.

emma: Will do. One more: there's a small localization note — Spanish translation team asked for shorter copy in the dashboard callout. Do we want separate copy or one concise English string?

kevin: Keep a single concise English string and ask localization to shorten as needed. Add TODO: `i18n: shorten for es/pt` in the PR description.

docs-bot: CI check started for PR #4127 — linting, link-check, and spellcheck.

emma: CI failed on link-check (two placeholders). I replaced the Billing FAQ placeholder with the actual link: https://redwood.ai/docs/billing/faq#timezones

docs-bot: Link-check: OK. Spellcheck: OK. Lint: warnings only (line-length).

linda: Quick QA ask: can QA validate the example outputs for the per-route quota snippet? Should be deterministic.

qa-bot: Assigned QA ticket DOCS-1986 to @qa-team — please validate sample responses and ensure the dashboard screenshot matches the example metrics.

raj: Minor suggestion on phrasing: change `per-route quotas` → `route-level quotas` for consistency with Console labels.

emma: Updated text and pushed. Also added a tiny dashboard panel image (annotated) — kept it grayscale to reduce file size.

kevin: Merge conflict on the Quickstart page (another PR changed the header). I can rebase if you want, emma.

emma: If you can, please. I want this in the weekly doc ship.

kevin: Rebased and resolved header changes. Verified links and ran local build.

docs-bot: PR #4127 — all checks passed. Ready for review.

linda: Reviewing now — will focus on examples + screenshot accuracy.

linda: LGTM for content and screenshot. Left one copy nit about `billing timezone` → `billing time zone` (two words).

emma: Fixed nit and squashed commits.

kevin: Approving now.

docs-bot: PR #4127 merged into `main` by kevin. Release note: "Compact billing examples and clarifications for burst credits, route-level quotas, and meter headers."

emma: Thanks everyone! I'll follow up with a short changelog entry for the product blog and ping localization for shorter translations. :tada:

raj: Great, thanks — closing the loop on these edge cases.

emma: Filing a quick post-ship follow-up ticket to track any support spam after the change: DOCS-1987."
